# dsh-supabase-tonulls-en

English DSH plugin variant for Supabase. Plugin metadata and toggle replies are in English; the bundled skill body is in English.

Install the EN package:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'git+https://github.com/tonulls/dsh-plugins.git#tonulls&path:/dsh-[name]-tonulls/dsh-supabase-tonulls/packages/dsh-supabase-tonulls-en'
```

The skill uses tools available to the current Agent.

Automatic selection is off by default. Use `/dsh-supabase-tonulls on` to enable it for the current Agent and `/dsh-supabase-tonulls off` to turn it off. Direct invocation is available with `/supabase`.
